items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I remember hearing Joe Sullivan who was one of our heroes

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember hearing some pretty good piano players up there if I could ever afford to go up there, which — Tommy Jordie’s. I remember hearing Joe Sullivan who was one of our heroes in — a piano player up there, a lot of piano players used to go through that place. So there was some jazz up there but basically no. There was a black club we used to go up and sit in with some of these guys. I remember the drummer had wooden leg.
